rule20.title: 20-20-20 Far Focus
rule20.desc: Look at an object at least 6 meters (20 ft) away—through a window or across the room. Let your gaze soften and relax your eyelids.

blink.title: Conscious Blinking
blink.desc: Blink slowly and completely 10 times. Keep your eyes gently closed for 1 full second on each blink to re-lubricate your corneas.

near-far.title: Near ↔ Far Focus Shift
near-far.desc: Hold your thumb 25 cm in front of you. Focus on it for 5 seconds, then shift focus to a distant object for 5 seconds. Repeat smoothly.

palming.title: Warm Palming
palming.desc: Rub your palms together for 3 seconds until warm. Gently cup them over your closed eyes without pressing and breathe deeply in darkness.

figure8.title: Gentle Figure-8
figure8.desc: Imagine a large horizontal ∞ about 3 meters ahead. Slowly trace it with your eyes only, keeping your head still and relaxed.

peripheral.title: Soft Directional Stretch
peripheral.desc: Look gently up, down, left, and right without straining. Pause 2 seconds at each side, then return to a soft distant gaze.

long-posture.title: Deep Visual & Posture Reset
long-posture.desc: Stand up from your desk, step away from all screens, roll your shoulders, stretch your neck, and drink some water while looking into the distance.

notification.break-title: Clarity: Time to rest your eyes
notification.break-finished-body: Your eyes are refreshed. You can return to your screen.
